title: A California Gold Rush Miner
hook: Standing in freezing mountain rivers until your boots rot.

scenes.text: In 1849, three hundred thousand prospectors rushed to California chasing rumors of rivers made of gold.
scenes.imagePrompt: Rugged California Sierra Nevada pine mountains with a rushing rocky river. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: In 1849, three hundred thousand prospectors rushed to California chasing rumors of rivers made of gold.

scenes.text: Your daily reality was standing knee-deep in ice-cold mountain snowmelt twelve hours a day panning gravel.

scenes.text: Prices were insane: an egg cost a dollar, and a pair of boots cost a full hundred dollars in gold dust.

scenes.text: You slept on dirt floors in drafty canvas tents, plagued by dysentery, cholera, and scurvy.
